articles.description:
Shiba Inu climbed 9% to $0.00001908 over the week. SHIB’s technical chart has shown recent strength, giving investors confidence that the project can continue rising. Could this momentum fuel a huge end-of-year rally? This chart pattern echoes yes.
 
SHIB’s Potential for a Year-End Rally 
Shiba Inu’s most recent price swings fit a classic bullish reversal pattern, a completed “falling wedge.” In many assets, this trend has historically foreshadowed large returns. For instance, SHIB last broke out of this pattern in late 2023, reaching a high of $0.000045 by March 2024—an astounding 450% rise from its original breakout. Technical analysis points to the potential for history to repeat itself. The coin recently broke through the $0.00001904 barrier level, which, if held, might pave the way fo…
articles.title: According to This Chart Pattern, An End-of-Year Rally Could Be in the Cards for Shiba Inu (SHIB)
